{"text": "The function `_arrange_dock_widgets` arranges widgets that are docked within a specified region.", "type": "intent"},
{"text": "The function `_arrange_dock_widgets` takes a parameter `dock_widgets`, which is a sequence of widgets with non-empty docks.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `_arrange_dock_widgets` takes a parameter `region`, the area where the widgets should be docked.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `_arrange_dock_widgets` takes a parameter `viewport`, the size of the viewport.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `_arrange_dock_widgets` calculates the placement for each widget based on its docking edge (top, bottom, left, or right).", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `_arrange_dock_widgets` adjusts widget placements for margins and alignment.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `_arrange_dock_widgets` uses the helper method `_get_box_model` to determine widget dimensions.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `_arrange_dock_widgets` uses the helper method `_align_size` for alignment adjustments.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `_arrange_dock_widgets` returns a tuple containing a list of widget placements and additional spacing around them.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `_arrange_dock_widgets` raises an `AssertionError` if an invalid docking edge is encountered.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The function `_arrange_dock_widgets` has no side effects and only computes and returns data without modifying external state.", "type": "behavioural"}
]
